description:
You are a mechanical design engineer at a sheet-metal fabrication shop. A colleague started a shelf-mounting L-bracket design and left the file `/home/ga/Documents/SolveSpace/bracket_start.slvs` open in SolveSpace. The sketch geometry is complete (all lines drawn and connected) but no dimensional constraints have been applied, so the file cannot be sent to the CNC press-brake.

The component specification sheet has been left on the desktop. Review the specification and add the required dimensional constraints to fully define the sketch, then save the constrained file as `/home/ga/Documents/SolveSpace/bracket_constrained.slvs`.
